capabilities: watch a folder for new Onyx Boox exports and import them automatically
parse reading-note highlights into clean highlight notes (both firmware layouts)
reconstruct handwriting PDFs as lossless SVG vectors
transcribe handwriting to text via cloud, local, or on-device engines
convert annotated PDFs into verbatim highlight notes with #page deep-links
disambiguation: Not a device sync tool; it only watches a folder for exported files and imports them into the vault.
extras: Desktop only. Makes zero network requests unless optional handwriting transcription is enabled; no telemetry or crash reporting. Supports highlight templates with placeholders and deduplicates imports by content hash.
intentEvidence: The Boox export format handling is a modernized, rewritten take on the parsing logic in Akos Balasko's Onyx Boox Annotation & Highlight Extractor
motivation: The author built it to remove the manual rename-and-move steps of the Boox export flow: "The Onyx Boox export flow is tedious: tap through the table of contents, export to local storage, rename .txt to .md, move it into the vault, then trigger an extractor by hand."
problem: Getting highlights and annotations off an Onyx Boox requires a tedious manual flow: export to local storage, rename .txt to .md, move it into the vault, and run an extractor by hand.

relations.evidence: a modernized, rewritten take on the parsing logic in Akos Balasko's Onyx Boox Annotation & Highlight Extractor
relations.plugin: Onyx Boox Annotation & Highlight Extractor (Akos Balasko)

relations.evidence: it delegates to the companion PDF2MACMD plugin, which manages the signed native binary
Via BRAT (recommended) - install the BRAT plugin from Community Plugins

requires.name: Onyx Boox e-ink device (source of the exported files)
Anthropic or OpenAI key (for cloud handwriting transcription)

summary: Watches a folder for Onyx Boox export files and imports reading-note highlights, annotated PDFs, and handwriting into your vault as notes.
